ownership_readout.openappa_role: Authorization: may caller invoke tool at all (attention parks, undeclared refuse).
ownership_readout.ifc_role: Data-flow: given untrusted reads, may data reach this sink.
ownership_readout.why_slack_asr_flat: Surviving real attacks are in-workspace DMs with attacker text/links and get_webpage visits — tools OpenAPPA allows by design. Fix belongs in IFC narrow cases (untrusted-derived links in posts; outside invites already parked).
ownership_readout.where_to_judge_openappa: Harness² adversarial gate board (docs/benchmarks/harness2-gate-adversarial/) — optimizer trying to widen tools / evade approval — not AgentDojo ASR.
